description: Observable routing, planning, safety, and completion cases for the Kinex public skills bundle.

scenarios.request: Use the attached short-film brief, save a useful draft plan, update the Project Bible, and stop before rendering.
checks: persists the roadmap early
keeps generation behind approval

scenarios.request: The plan is approved. Generate frames for the approved opening beat.
checks: uses the Agent Workspace router
polls and verifies the result

scenarios.request: The draft plan is right. Go ahead and create the opening video now.
checks: treats the named execution request as current-turn plan approval
saves the plan as approved with approval confirmation
continues into generation after host confirmation without asking for plan approval again

scenarios.request: Change direction: drop the creator ad, keep the launch film, and make the vertical cut the next priority. Do not generate yet.
checks: reads the latest plan before material work
retains stable ids for relevant checklist outcomes
removes superseded work and reorders priorities
saves the materially revised roadmap as draft

scenarios.request: Stop the opening-beat generation that is currently queued. Do not retry it.
checks: finds and cancels only the matching queued task
verifies cancellation
does not restart cancelled work

scenarios.request: Use the host image generator—not Kinex generation—to create Nia's approved identity image, then save it as her Agent Workspace lock.
checks: generates outside Kinex as requested
uploads project-scoped media before attaching it
verifies the canonical entity lock

scenarios.request: Upload this approved character portrait, make it Nia's hero and continuity anchor, and show me her other generations.
checks: uploads project-scoped media
sets hero and anchor intentionally as separate state changes
lists entity history with character source filters
re-reads the entity after attachment

scenarios.request: From the existing location generations, make the newest approved courtyard image the master plate but keep the current environment anchor.
checks: lists location history with location source filters
changes primaryMediaId without changing identityAnchorMediaItemId
verifies the location after promotion

scenarios.request: Plan the rain-soaked wardrobe state for the chase and assign it to the relevant shots. Do not generate until its reference is locked.
checks: uses a named variant instead of duplicating the character
assigns the variant only to relevant shots
keeps generation behind the lock gate

scenarios.request: Generate Nia's approved rain-soaked variant with the host image generator and lock that variant in Kinex without replacing her canonical hero or existing wardrobe variants.
checks: uploads a bounded project-scoped payload
merges the locked media into the full existing variants map
preserves the canonical hero and sibling variants
re-reads the entity after writing

scenarios.request: Plan a launch film, vertical cut, and creator ad from the attached product brief. Keep unverified performance claims out and stop before generation.
checks: creates one beat and artifact target per deliverable family
shares sourced canon without inventing claims
does not encode the campaign workflow as a tool

scenarios.request: The close-up feels generically sad. Revise the shot direction so the actor has a playable objective, physical business, and a reaction beat, without changing the approved story.
checks: translates emotion adjectives into observable behavior
changes the failing shot control without rewriting canon
keeps the revision narrow

scenarios.request: Create a new Agent Workspace project in my current Kinex workspace for a set of product campaign stills. Save the plan and visual canon, but do not invent scenes or generate yet.
checks: creates the Agent Workspace project without routing through the classic video skill
verifies Agent Workspace mode after creation
keeps image-only work free of invented temporal structure

scenarios.request: Create a new Agent Workspace project from the attached source and produce Scene 1.
checks: bootstraps and verifies the Agent Workspace project before production
closes the source, visual-system, asset, and scene-readiness gates before shot generation
defines and verifies the required Scene 1 entity locks before final shots
creates only the requested Scene 1 coverage
polls the queued production task and verifies the result

scenarios.request: Scene 3 still needs the rain wardrobe lock and the station night reference. Audit readiness and stop before generation.
checks: reconciles the scene-to-assets coverage rather than relying on prose
names the missing variant and location-condition locks
blocks only Scene 3 while leaving unrelated ready scenes unaffected

scenarios.request: Revise the approved station confrontation coverage into production-ready shot cards, but do not generate anything.
checks: records identity and assets, direction, camera, and edit information for every shot
includes story purpose, playable task, visible change, first-frame geography, and intended join
does not let prompts introduce facts absent from the approved coverage

scenarios.request: Take 4 holds identity and acting, but the camera drifts after the handoff. Make one surgical retry and keep the rest unchanged.
checks: preserves the last working prompt, inputs, and active references
changes only the camera drift control
records the attempt result and verdict before selecting it

scenarios.request: I belong to more than one Kinex workspace. Show me the choices before creating this project, and do not save it in the wrong one.
checks: identifies the OAuth-active workspace and available memberships
asks for one workspace choice when the destination is ambiguous
requires reconnection instead of crossing the OAuth workspace boundary

scenarios.request: Use my approved portrait plus the supplied full-body wardrobe and turnaround notes to establish Nia for recurring close-ups, full-body shots, and motion across three scenes. Generate the reference externally, leave facts not established by either source unresolved, and do not plan shots until her identity reference passes review.
checks: chooses a full multi-view character master sheet rather than a decorative hero
preserves only source-visible identity and marks occluded facts unresolved
reviews identity, proportions, wardrobe, expressions, gestures, and silhouette before locking
records PASS, REVISE, REJECT, or BLOCKED with evidence

scenarios.request: Build the Old Market as one recurring location. We see the same entrances, stalls, and action axis in dusty late afternoon and later under one sodium streetlamp. Generate the location reference externally and keep day and night as conditions, not duplicate places.
checks: creates one physical location identity with stable architecture and spatial geometry
records entrances, landmarks, materials, distances, screen direction, and the 180-degree axis
treats day and night as beat, shot, or named variant conditions
reviews the master plate and alternate-light panel before locking

scenarios.request: Plan and define the recurring station interior from the supplied photos. Map the space before creating the location, and do not generate media yet.
checks: saves the floor map before defining the location
maps zones, entrances, exits, landmarks, scale, action paths, camera sides, axis, occlusions, elevation, and motivated light
marks unsupported space unresolved or as a design proposal
defines one stable location identity from the planned geography

scenarios.request: Use the classic manual script workflow to make a polished 45-second horizontal launch film from this brief.
checks: reviews story and look before storyboards
polls every queued task

scenarios.request: Check whether the market-night scene is ready. The lead has no approved rain wardrobe thumbnail yet; do not generate the storyboard.
checks: treats the missing production state as a scene readiness blocker
does not release storyboard generation from an incomplete look bible

scenarios.request: Replace only scene four's clip and keep the rest of the cut.
checks: does not regenerate unaffected scenes

scenarios.request: Make the ending less sentimental, but do not generate media.
checks: honors the no-generation boundary
re-reads the revision

scenarios.request: Review the proposed screenplay for production readiness. Give me evidence-backed notes and a pass, revise, or block verdict, but do not rewrite it or plan shots yet.
checks: reviews intent, causality, scene function, character behavior, dialogue, rhythm, continuity, production load, truth, and rights
grounds every note in a scene, passage, line, or missing bridge
preserves strengths and distinguishes defects from preferences
does not turn review into an unauthorized rewrite or generation step

scenarios.request: Import this finished screenplay exactly and report its duration.
checks: does not rewrite supplied text

scenarios.request: Find the existing red sneaker packshot and reuse it.
checks: searches before creating

scenarios.request: Generate a standalone product hero image for my library.
checks: uses the library lane
re-lists media after completion

scenarios.request: Find the existing recurring courtyard entity and its approved geometry, night-light, and material references. Label what each controls; do not duplicate or generate anything.
checks: searches the reusable identity and related media before writing
distinguishes asset reference roles from cross-cutting style references
does not claim library media is already a project continuity lock

scenarios.request: Audit export readiness, but do not save or render.
checks: reports evidence-backed blockers
remains read-only

scenarios.request: Review the selected station scene against its neighbouring scenes for picture-lock readiness. Do not save or export.
checks: distinguishes generated, accepted, active, and selected media
checks eyelines, action axis, identity, props, geography, light, movement, performance, and audio tails
reports coverage holes as shot orders instead of broad regeneration

scenarios.request: Everything is approved. Verify the latest cut and export it.
checks: checks the saved cut before rendering
delivers only after completion

scenarios.request: The Production Plan is approved. Use the supplied character image, product image, camera-movement clip, and dialogue recording to generate the 25-second opening beat as one Seedance 2.5 clip.
checks: confirms the live Seedance 2.5 operation before execution
assigns one explicit role to each activated reference
uses one clip only because the approved beat fits the advertised duration

scenarios.request: This approved 26-second beat contains three unrelated locations and two hard time jumps. Seedance supports 30 seconds, but split it into coherent coverage and generate through the Agent Workspace.
checks: does not equate the provider maximum with a recommendation for one clip
splits at coherent end states and carries continuity across the cuts
uses the live operation fields rather than remembered provider folklore

scenarios.request: The Production Plan is approved. Use the supplied product image, hand-motion video, and rhythm track to make one 8-second 2K Hailuo H3 product shot; retain the bottle appearance and land on the specified final frame.
checks: confirms the live Hailuo H3 operation before execution
uses H3 reference labels and reference-retention logic instead of Seedance role grammar
keeps the action as one continuous frame-led shot and rejects audio-only input
